visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A four-way split screen montage showcases a male subject with short, dark hair undergoing multiple facial cosmetic procedures. Practitioners wearing white latex gloves apply various devices, including a cool-tip applicator and a laser-like probe, to his cheeks and forehead while he lies still with eyes closed. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of a medical clinic's waiting area. Plush, beige sectional sofas are arranged along a wall beneath large windows that offer a bright view of the outdoors. A large flat-screen television is mounted on the wall above the seating, and potted plants and framed photos are visible on shelves. (3) Close-up shots display a printed price list in Korean and Chinese for various medical aesthetic treatments like ONDA and InMode. The camera then cuts back to the main male character sitting in a gray treatment chair, smiling at the lens while wearing a blue denim jacket. (4) Detailed sequences show specific treatments being administered. A technician marks the subject's face with a white pen to outline treatment areas. This is followed by the application of the ONDA device on the jawline and the Ultherapy probe on the cheeks. A white, thick cream mask is also applied to the subject's face. (5) The subject interacts with a self-service tax refund kiosk, pointing at the touchscreen which displays scanning instructions. Later, he is seen holding up documents with 'Ultherapy 100' stamps and showing his face, which appears bright and smooth after the treatments. (6) The video concludes with the subject making a peace sign and smiling broadly towards the camera in the clinic setting. QR codes for social media contact are overlaid on the screen, followed by a shot of a building directory sign and a final cheerful shot of the subject.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, layered over an upbeat electronic pop track with a consistent 126 BPM beat. The music features bright synth melodies and a driving percussion section that maintains high arousal. (2) As the narrator describes the clinic and the treatments, his voice remains clear and articulate, with frequent pitch modulations expressing excitement and positivity. The music continues without interruption, serving as a high-energy bed for the voice-over. (3) During the technical explanation of the ONDA and Ultherapy procedures, the speaker's tone becomes slightly more informative but retains its enthusiastic pace. The acoustic environment is very clean, indicating high-quality studio-style post-production where unwanted noise is absent. (4) The track concludes with the narrator's cheerful recommendation and contact information, maintaining the same high-tempo music and vocal energy until the final second, with subtle whoosh sound effects occasionally highlighting visual transitions.
